correctness.rationale: The conic Q(X,Y,Z)=X²+Y²+Z²+XY+XZ+YZ has nonsingular Hessian determinant 4. Power pullback is étale away from coordinate axes and intersects each axis transversely at 2n points, ensuring smoothness for every integer n≥3. The chain-rule Hessian is n³(xyz)^(n−2)R_n(x^n,y^n,z^n), with R_n|Q=(2n−1)²[3(n−1)e1³+(5n−1)e3]. Normalize e1=1 and e2=1: the residual six points are all permutations of roots of t³−t²+t+3(n−1)/(5n−1), with discriminant −48(11n²−16n+6)/(5n−1)² nonzero and no zero roots for n≥3. Each has n² étale lifts and simple Hessian zero/contact 3, giving 6n² off-axis. At each of 6n axis points restricting F to the tangent gives exact multiplicity n. Total weights 6n(n−2)+6n²=12n(n−1)=3(2n)(2n−2), exhausting the full Hessian intersection degree. Independent symbolic checks reproduced invariant Hessian expansion and examples n=3,4; proof of infinite family is algebraic, not experimental.
